channel_targets:
- conda-forge main

- '15'

- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10

  python:
    min_pin: x.x
    max_pin: x.x

- 3.15.* *_cp315

- linux-64

- - c_compiler_version

name: pymongo
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: pymongo
  version: "4.18.1"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: d04134ff4ea0e7d14b6e2ef23dbfe06112a99318c9578b213d2dee9060b23dce

build:
  number: 0
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-cache-dir --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - hatchling >1.24
    - setuptools >=65.0
    - hatch-requirements-txt >=0.4.1
  run:
    - python
    - dnspython >=2.7.0,<3.0.0

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - bson
        - gridfs
        - pymongo
      pip_check: true
  # Three tests seem to fail on PPC64LE and PyPy
  # test_monitoring test_gridfs_spec test_legacy_api
  - if: unix and not (ppc64le or python_impl == 'pypy')
    then:
      files:
        # rattler-build ships test files inside the package, so only pick up
        # what run_the_tests.sh actually needs rather than the whole test tree.
        source:
          - pyproject.toml
          - test/*.py
          - test/certificates/
          - test/unified-test-format/
        recipe:
          - run_the_tests.sh
      requirements:
        run:
          # osx-64 mongodb >=8.0.23 ships an arm64-only mongod; pin <8 until fixed.
          # See https://github.com/conda-forge/mongodb-feedstock/issues/121.
          - mongodb <8
          - setuptools
          - pytest >=8.2
          - pytest-asyncio >=0.24.0
          - mockupdb
      script:
        - bash run_the_tests.sh

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo-python-driver
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Python driver for MongoDB http://www.mongodb.org
  repository: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo-python-driver
